title: Barcelona Private Tour
text: We went on this tour with Gloria, who is very nice and knowledgeable. She took us to many sites in Barcelona and helped us get oriented to the city. We are a family with two teenagers and she kept them engaged the whole time. Highly recommend this tour!
author: sierralala

title: Touring Barcelona
text:
We visited Barcelona over three days following a cruise.  Letango arranged to have us picked up at the port with a driving tour while we waited for our hotel to become available.

 Our guide, Gloria, was extremely personable, knowledgeable.  We had arranged tours the next two days to La Sagrada Familia and Montserrat and Gloria was our guide for each.  Each time, she made us laugh, feel comfortable and helped us gain a deeper appreciation for what we’re seeing. 

 Gloria also provided excellent restaurant and churro recommendations. I would highly recommend Letango and Gloria for your next vis
author: M4278PQbriank

title: Barcelona at its best!!
text: We planned a walking tour with Letango of the Gothic Quarter. We had Marc as our tour guide who has unbelievable knowledge and kept my family of four engaged the entire time.  We learned about the history and he took us to some of his favorite places. He was flexible with our requests and gave us wonderful suggestions for after. I can’t say enough about this private tour..  Letango  ensured our trip to Spain was a success. Their tours are exceptional and done by locals. I can’t commend them enough!
author: melissamB785RJ
